name: pyg4ometry

about.summary: Python code for rapid creation and conversion of radiation transport Monte Carlo (Geant4 and Fluka) geometries
Python code for rapid creation and conversion of radiation transport Monte Carlo (Geant4 and Fluka) geometries

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.4.6"

package:
  name: pyg4ometry
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/p/pyg4ometry/pyg4ometry-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 37cd80eda2c3bea3b8dacab324d8215ef9098c1c51d8bffd0a2d1a26d077341e

build:
  number: 2
  script:
    - if: unix
      then: export CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL=${CPU_COUNT}
    - if: win
      then:
        - set CXXFLAGS=/std:c++17
        - set CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL=%CPU_COUNT%
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      # Not left to pip: its Windows launcher bakes in the build-time prefix
      # and breaks on relocation.
      - pyg4ometry = pyg4ometry.cli:mainNoExceptions
  dynamic_linking:
    overlinking_behavior: error
    overdepending_behavior: error

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - cmake >=3.20
    - make
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - numpy
        - pybind11
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - cython
    - pybind11 >=2.6
    - numpy
    - setuptools >=42
    - setuptools-scm >=3.4
    - scikit-build-core ==0.5
    # `cgal` is the SWIG python binding; the headers are in cgal-cpp
    - cgal-cpp
    - occt
    - mpfr
    - gmp
    - if: linux
      then: libgl-devel
  ignore_run_exports:
    by_name:
      # libgl-devel is only needed for OpenCASCADE's Visualization component
      # to resolve at configure time; nothing here links libGL.
      - libgl
  run:
    - python
    - importlib-resources
    - antlr4-python3-runtime ==4.13.1
    - matplotlib-base
    - networkx >=3
    - pandas
    - scipy
    - sympy >=1.7
    - vtk

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pyg4ometry
        - pyg4ometry.pycgal
        - pyg4ometry.pycsg
        - pyg4ometry.pyoce
      pip_check: true

  - script:
      - python roundtrip.py
      - pyg4ometry --help
    files:
      recipe:
        - roundtrip.py

  - package_contents:
      strict: true
      bin:
        - pyg4ometry
      site_packages:
        - pyg4ometry
        - pyg4ometry.pycgal
        - pyg4ometry.pycsg
        - pyg4ometry.pyoce
      files:
        - if: win
          then:
            - Scripts/pyg4ometry*
            - Lib/site-packages/pyg4ometry/**
            - Lib/site-packages/pyg4ometry-${{ version }}.dist-info/**
          else:
            - bin/pyg4ometry
            - lib/python*/site-packages/pyg4ometry/**
            - lib/python*/site-packages/pyg4ometry-${{ version }}.dist-info/**
        - etc/conda/test-files/pyg4ometry/**

about:
  license: GPL-3.0-only
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Python code for rapid creation and conversion of radiation transport Monte Carlo (Geant4 and Fluka) geometries
  homepage: https://github.com/g4edge/pyg4ometry
  repository: https://github.com/g4edge/pyg4ometry
  documentation: https://pyg4ometry.readthedocs.io

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - chrisburr
    - stewartboogert
    - gipert
